questions.q: Classify every noon sakinah and tanween in 69:6 to 7.
questions.a: عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ ikhfa; بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ ikhfa; صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ izhar; لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ idgham with ghunnah; أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا izhar; حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ikhfa; نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ izhar.

questions.q: Rule audit (pupil PDF): classify the noon sakinah and tanween in Al-Haqqah 69:40 to 52. Today's rota group recites Al-Mulk 67:1 to 10.
questions.a: رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ ikhfa; شَاعِرٍۢ قَلِيلًۭا ikhfa; قَلِيلًۭا مَّا idgham; تَنزِيلٌۭ ikhfa (in word) and مِّن idgham; مِّن رَّبِّ idgham no ghunnah; مِنْهُ izhar; مِنكُم ikhfa; مِّنْ أَحَدٍ izhar; أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ izhar; لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ idgham no ghunnah; لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى izhar.

questions.q: Extend: give the four izhar mutlaq words.
Stretch: why is ikhfa before ق heavier than before ت?
questions.a: The hum takes the colour of the next letter; ق is a heavy (isti'la) letter.
A) Iqlab. Tanween before ب is always iqlab; the small meem in the mushaf shows it.

questions.q: Think again: Why do you think the same 'n' sound changes in four different ways? What would recitation sound like without these rules?
questions.a: The rules make the flow easy and beautiful; without them recitation would be choppy, and they are how the Qur'an was recited to the Prophet ﷺ.
